description: This is a test class for the JobTitleDao within the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests that verify the behavior of data access methods related to job titles, including fetching lists, filtering, deletion, and retrieving specific entities.

classes.name: JobTitleDaoTest
classes.description: Unit testing class for the JobTitleDao component in the OrangeHRM project, testing retrieval, deletion, and counting of JobTitle entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of JobTitleDao, and populates test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleList
methods.description: Verifies that getJobTitleList returns the correct number of job titles with expected names.

methods.name: testGetJobTitlesForEmployee
methods.description: Tests that getJobTitlesForEmployee returns correct job titles associated with a specific employee ID.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleListWithInactiveJobTitles
methods.description: Checks that getJobTitleList includes inactive job titles when a parameter is set to false.

methods.name: testDeleteJobTitle
methods.description: Ensures that deleteJobTitle removes the specified job titles and returns the correct count.

methods.name: testGetJobTitleById
methods.description: Validates retrieval of a JobTitle entity by ID and verifies the name.

methods.name: testGetJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of JobSpecificationAttachment entity by ID and verifies the filename.

methods.name: testGetJobTitles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of job titles with and without active filter using search parameters.

methods.name: testGetJobTitlesCount
methods.description: Verifies counting of job titles with and without active filter.
